verses.en: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.sm: Levi i vasega e luafulu ma le fa O vasega nei o le fanauga a Arona. O atalii o Arona; o Natapu, ma Aviu, o Eleasaro, ma Itamaro.

verses.en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
verses.sm: Ua oti Natapu ma Aviu, a o ola lo la tamá, e leai ni a la fanau; ona fai ai lea o le faiva o faitaulaga e Eleasaro ma Itamaro.

verses.en: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
verses.sm: Ua tofia e Tavita o Satoka nai le fanauga a Eleasaro, ma Aimeleka nai le fanauga a Itamaro, e tusa ma lo laua tofiga i la laua galuega.

verses.en: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
verses.sm: Ua sili le toatele o matai sili na maua i le fanauga a Eleasaro i le fanauga a Itamaro; o latou vasega ia. Ua toasefulu ma le toaono o matai sili o le fanauga a Eleasaro i aiga o latou tama, a e toavalu o le fanauga a Itamaro i aiga o latou tama.

verses.en: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.sm: Ua tofia i latou i le vili, o lea vasega ma lea vasega; aua o e na pule i le malumalu, ma e na pule i mea a le Atua, nai le fanauga a Eleasaro ma le fanauga a Itamaro i latou.

verses.en: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
verses.sm: O Semaia le atalii o Natanielu o le tusiupu, o lo sa Levi, na ia tusia i latou i luma o le tupu, ma alii, ma Satoka le faitaulaga, ma Aimeleka le atalii o Aviata, ma matai sili o le au faitaulaga ma sa Levi; ua aumaia aiga o tama o le tasi mo Eleasaro, ua aumaia foi le tasi mo Itamaro.

verses.en: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.sm: O le vili muamua na faasaga ia Ioaripa, o lona lua ia Ietaia,

verses.en: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.sm: o lona tolu ia Harima, O lona fa ia Seorima,

verses.en: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.sm: o lona lima ia Malekia, o lona ono ia Meamina,

verses.en: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.sm: o lona fitu ia Hakosa, o lona valu ia Avia,

verses.en: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.sm: o lona iva ia Iesua, o lona sefulu ia Sekania,

verses.en: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le tasi ia Eliasipa, o lona sefulu ma le lua ia lakima,

verses.en: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le tolu ia Hupa, o lona sefulu ma le fa ia lesepeapo,

verses.en: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.sm: O lona sefulu ma le lima ia Pileka, ma lona sefulu ma le ono la Imere,

verses.en: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le fitu ia Hesera, o lona sefulu ma le valu ia Hafesesa,

verses.en: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
verses.sm: o lona sefulu ma le iva ia Petakia, o lona lua sefulu ia Esekielu,

verses.en: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
verses.sm: o lona lua sefulu ma le tasi ia lakinu, o lona lua sefulu ma le lua ia Kamula,

verses.en: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
verses.sm: o lona lua sefulu ma le tolu ia Tilaia, o lona lua sefulu ma le fa ia Maasia.

verses.en: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.sm: O latou tofiga ia i a latou galuega e o atu i le fale o le ALII, e tusa i lo latou masani mai ia Arona lo latou tama, e pei ona poloaiina o ia e le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
verses.sm: O i latou nei o e ua totoe o le fanauga a Levi; o le atalii o Amaramo, o Sepuelu; o le atalii o Sepuelu, o Ietaia.

verses.en: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
verses.sm: O Reapea; O atalii foi o Reapea, o le muamua o Isea.

verses.en: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
verses.sm: O lo sa Isara; o Salome; o le atalii o Salome o lata.

verses.en: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.sm: O atalii o Heperona, o Ieria le muamua, o Amaria le toalua, o Iaaseelu le toatolu, o Ikamamo le toafa.

verses.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
verses.sm: O le atalii o Usialu, o Mika; o le atalii o Mika, o Samira.

verses.en: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
verses.sm: O le uso o Mika, o Isea; o le atalii o Isea, o Sakaria.

verses.en: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
verses.sm: O atalii o Merari, o Maali ma Musi; o le atalii o laasia, o Peno.

verses.en: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.sm: O atalii o Merari ia laasia, O Peno, ma Soama, ma Sakuro, ma Iperi.

verses.en: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.sm: O Maali, o lona atalii Eleasaro. ua leai ni ona atalii.

verses.en: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
verses.sm: O Kiso; o le atalii o Kiso, o leramaelu.

verses.en: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
verses.sm: A o atalii o Musi, o Maali, ma Eteru, ma Ieremota. O le fanauga ia a sa Levi, e tusa ma le aiga o Jatou tamá.

verses.en: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
verses.sm: Ua latou faia foi le vili, pei o latou uso o le fanauga a Arona i luma o le tupu o Tavita, ma Satoka, ma Aimeleka, ma matai sili o Je au faitaulaga ma sa Levi, o matai sili atoa ma o latou uso e iti. e O Tavita ma alii o “au ua vavaeeseina mo le galuega i atalii o
